correctness.rationale: A diameter-two geodesic triple is an induced P3; pairwise-intersecting edge cliques in a simple K_n are exactly common-center stars or the 3-edge triangle. The disjoint-support partition and precise three maximality obstructions prove the two component assembly formulas and boundaries for all n. A separate verifier exhaustively recomputes coefficients at n=2..6 and checks extremal degrees n=3..49; no finite-only generalization is used.

value.rationale: These are full uniform cardinality polynomials for an established graph family and a canonical graph invariant (as opposed to numerical minima). The maximal polynomial enumerates inclusion-minimal cluster-deletion solutions across all sizes, and the two minimum-count closed formulas distinguish the multiplicities hidden by the known cardinality results. The counting construction applies to every n and provides computable coefficients without exhaustive subsets.
